# LINSILK

> LINSILK is a made-to-measure silk and linen clothing house based in Geneva, Switzerland. Every piece is cut and sewn to the customer's own measurements in 2–4 weeks, in 100% silk or 100% linen cloth.

Pieces are ordered online: choose a piece, choose its colour from swatches of its cloth (48 silk colours, 40 linen colours), enter 15 measurements. There are no fittings; customers measure themselves or use any tailor. Orders are dispatched from Geneva with tracking. Contact: hello@bylinsilk.com.

## The house

- [About LINSILK](https://bylinsilk.com/about): what the house is, with the facts at a glance
- [How made-to-measure works](https://bylinsilk.com/made-to-measure): ordering, price, fittings, timing
- [The cloth](https://bylinsilk.com/cloth): pure silk (plain, jacquard, brocade) and pure linen
- [Questions](https://bylinsilk.com/care/questions): the answer bank
